sources.title: Clarity in League
sources.applied: Readability starts with action silhouette and direction. Group by importance and remove competing decoration. Applied to four strike slots, medicine/retreat hierarchy and real enemy intent.

sources.title: Behind the Scenes of VFX Updates
sources.applied: Correct misleading basic visual communication before thematic ornament; iterate on a real baseline and test. Applied to seven move forms and cold actor, not generic ring overlays.

limits: Historical MOBA development prose, not current idle-game playtest. Embedded media not watched.
Three-second cycle, atomic result deadline, finite authorization, exact budgets and local composition are project choices, not Riot values or certification.
Local engineering and pixel review do not replace user acceptance of overall game feel or long-term balance.
